title: Tusker Cavern
subtitle: Kill Goldenback Tusker (level 30), no quest
steps: In the Facility Hub, take the level 15 portal to Tusker Cavern.
Kill Goldenback Tusker in the dungeon.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Tuskers take 0.25 to 0.4 electric, 0.5 slash, 0.75 bludgeon, cold and acid, and full pierce (1.0) and fire (1.0). Use pierce or fire.

notes.title: Leaving
notes.body: The entrance is at the top. Both Surface exits are on the lowest level, at the west and east ends. The route goes to the west one.
